summary: A simple and functional script that demonstrates basic sentiment analysis using the Hugging Face transformers pipeline.
A clean and functional Python script that utilizes the Hugging Face transformers library to perform sentiment analysis on a list of hardcoded sentences and prints the output.
A command-line PDF parser and search chatbot that extracts text from an Indian Penal Code PDF, splits it into sections using regex, and offers a basic keyword search over section names and content.

A basic CLI chatbot that reads an IPC PDF file, parses its sections using regular expressions, and allows users to search them. It works for simple use cases but lacks error handling, runs code directly on import, and uses inefficient string concatenation.
